List Available Layers in GeoSDOT and rsdot

Source: R/list_available_layers.R
list_available_layers.Rd

Retrieves the complete catalog of spatial layers supported by the rsdot package, detailing the layer key, thematic domain, source layer in GeoServer, geographic partitioning level, and the recommended R access function.

Usage

list_available_layers(domain = NULL, show_details = FALSE)

Arguments

domain

Character. Optional filter by thematic domain: "limits", "transport", "services", "demography", "telecom", "hazards", "mobility", "cadastre", or NULL (default, returns all).

show_details

Logical. If TRUE, returns additional technical metadata such as GeoServer layer names and partition columns. Default is FALSE.

Value

A data.frame containing the catalog of layers.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# List all supported layers
list_available_layers()

# Filter only transportation layers
list_available_layers(domain = "transport")
} # }
